name: Haru wa Akebono, Ware wa Bakemono
original_name: 春はあけぼの、我はバケモノ
source:
One day, a student in your class stops coming to school.

As their teacher, you visit their home.

What awaits you is no ordinary visit,
but a fragile and unsettling encounter.

A girl who clings to fill the emptiness inside her.
A girl who smiles as she tests the limits of adults.
A girl quietly seeking help within a broken everyday life.

Your choices will shape the outcome.

Will it lead to salvation?
Dependency?
Or ruin?

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644290/__Spring_at_Dawn_I_Am_a_Monster/]Steam[/url]]
